attributes.name: Cannibal Haunt
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, banish either a card of your choice from your hand or the top card of your deck.

Display the haunt next to your deck. For each Haunt displayed next to your deck, the difficulty of your checks is increased by 1. At the end of the scenario, banish all Haunts.

When you encounter the Cannibal Haunt, you may immediately attempt to close this location.

corrections.corrected_text: The text for Cannibal Haunt should be similarly updated by replacing the text: "Place the haunt next to your character card. For each Haunt next to your character card..." with "Display the haunt next to your deck. For each Haunt displayed next to your deck...".
corrections.issue: The text for Cabin in the Snow was updated to use Paizo's preferred language of "displaying" cards adjacent to a player's "deck". This update made Cannibal Haunt's mechanics inconsistent with Cabin in the Snow, despite the Scenario explicitly requiring their interaction.
